accepted.disposition: Restrict the N-2 localization claim to f_i outside the prime and state that the surviving images still generate the unit ideal.
Correct a R-completion-submodule to an R-completion-submodule.
Split off the field case p=m and use one fixed g in m minus p to rescale the field generators.
Remove the unjustified normality restriction from the arbitrary Nagata-domain reduction.
Insert the missing subject we in the replacement clause.
Use R[X] for the polynomial indeterminate rather than R[x], where x is the fixed element.
Restrict the maximal-ideal quantifier to maximal ideals of S' lying over the fixed maximal ideal.
Dispose of x=0 before invoking a criterion requiring x nonzero.
Insert the missing plus sign after the ellipsis in the polynomial.
Prove B is local from its one-prime special fibre and identify the maximal-adic and mB-adic topologies before applying the completion lemma.
